title: Pals Rewards Tier Qualification Chart: Spend Thresholds and Retention
content:
The free tiers of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** are earned by qualifying spend. The chart below gives, for every tier, the qualifying spend in one calendar year that earns it, the spend window evaluated for a free tier, and the number of calendar years after the year of qualification through which an earned free tier is kept.

| Tier | Qualifying spend in one calendar year that earns the tier | Spend window evaluated | Retention after the year of qualification |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | $0.00 (joined free) | current or prior calendar year | 0 years |
| Pals Rewards Insider | $250.00 | current or prior calendar year | 1 year |
| Pals Rewards VIP | $750.00 | current or prior calendar year | 1 year |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | $0.00 (bought, not earned) | current or prior calendar year | 0 years |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | $0.00 (bought, not earned) | current or prior calendar year | 0 years |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | $0.00 (bought, not earned) | current or prior calendar year | 0 years |

**Thresholds in practice (hypothetical spend figures).** A membership with $249.99 of qualifying spend in the year has not reached the Pals Rewards Insider threshold; at $250.00 it has. At $749.99 it has not reached Pals Rewards VIP; at $750.00 it has.

**Retention in practice.** A free tier with a retention of 1 year, earned during one calendar year, is kept through the end of the following calendar year.

**Paid tiers.** The three Tailwise Plus tiers show no threshold because they are bought with a fee and never earned by spend.
